ai-11.title: Lexical and dense retrieval fusion
ai-11.query: rare error code timeout retry search

sentences.text: Error E417 means the request exceeded the upstream deadline.
Retry only transient timeouts, using a bounded attempt count and jitter.

Reciprocal-rank fusion combines positions from ranked lists without comparing raw scores.

Coverage asks whether the candidate contains the important query terms or evidence.
A fixed candidate set makes retrieval recall and reranking quality separate measurements.
